work_origin_setting: Move probe to machine X230 Y245 toolhead Z231.30 through the staged safe moves; operator uses controller/Luban Set Work Origin at that held pose. Verify work X0 Y0 Z0 by fresh heartbeat before any cutter path. MCP has no sanctioned direct XYZ work-origin write.
goto_condition: Use goto_work_origin only after a machine-Z328 retract and verify the live G54 offset; the destination X230 Y245 is outside the measured stock. A work origin alone cannot make an arbitrary low-Z traverse safe.
tool_change_condition: Measure probe before physical swap, measure installed endmill after swap, apply the measured length offset or complete touchscreen wizard; then reverify work frame and clearances.
cut_release: This file registers review-path coordinates only. Holder and jaw clearance, stock model, B direction and first-entry moves remain to be validated.
